title: Outside the Prison
text:
You've escaped! Three paths lie ahead of you:

- West: A thick bramble of poisonous plants. Navigating will shorten your journey, but at what cost?
- North: The safest path to avoid hazards or guards: through the forest.
- East: The most direct yet most dangerous path to your destination. Will you risk it?
dmNotes:
# Who's in this scene

- the party only
- optionally if the party fought their way out of the prison you can add more guards here for them to fight

# What you need to do

Explain the three paths that lie ahead of the party, shown below as well as in the handout for them to see

# The three paths

## East

- Going west requires every member of the party to pass a "Climb / Jump" check
- You can decide the roll required, we suggest a 10 or higher to avoid the "Poisoned" condition
- The party will end up the Gator swamp, but you should move them closer to the finish on the bottom-left to reward their risk of climbing the poisonous plants

## North

This will take the party directly to the Gator Swamp at the suggested spawn point. 

## East

This will take the party to the Courtyard scene.
